extra_context: We're a small family law practice run by me, Dana Hart, in Burlington. We help people through divorce, custody, and adoption — mostly parents who are scared, stressed, and don't know what any of the legal words mean. I want the site to feel calm and honest, like sitting across a kitchen table from someone who's got your back, not a stuffy intimidating law office. The one thing that makes us different: every new client gets a free 30-minute "plain English" first call where we just explain what's actually going to happen, no jargon and no pressure to sign anything.
